viewing_check: Confirm it is Huon pine (pale yellow, fine grain, sweet pine smell on a fresh scratch, pin knots). Measure length, width and thickness. Check how far the rot at the top end runs in (cut-off loss) and whether the rest has splits or end checks. Compare against neighbouring lots 1122 and 1124 if bidding on several.
